items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Suzette's sister Dolores who had been a model and who was tall and quite extravagant, was travelling with us... Dolores and Caspoil didn't get along together... Dolores, Lily and I were ready to go back

ctx.x: Lily being Swiss knew about some of the laws of that country and told me that we should give all the things that were of any value that we had with us to the owner of the boarding house to keep for us, because whenever a law suit was filed against someone in Switzerland, the law could confiscate everything except that which was necessary for a person to use in his employment. In my case, it was my instrument and clothing. I had a movie camera, a new projector, and a few other things of value, and we gave these to…

I had an engagement after St. Gallen to work two weeks in St. Moritz. I finished at the "Trischli" the 28th of February and started at the Rosatsch Hotel Excelsior, which also had a casino, the first of March. Suzette and Caspoil had become real tight together, and things were going fine for them. Suzette's sister Dolores who had been a model and who was tall and quite extravagant, was travelling with us, but it was Suzette who was paying for her. Dolores and Caspoil didn't get along together, and sometimes had…
For three nights, Benny Waters was high and bugging everybody by talking loud when someone else was talking a solo. He was talking mostly to Suzette who was trying to keep him cool, but in vain.
